second_order: recruiting and equipping Paragon pixel builders
theme_note: Calls, coordinates, location answers, and templates give people a target and the means to join it; willingness and recruitment vary within the practice.

second_order: sourcing and debating character art for the canvas
theme_note: Members credit the art source and test colours, thumbnails, and the age of the supplied set before treating it as a buildable design.

second_order: explaining Reddit's place event to a newcomer
theme_note: A question and answer make the unfamiliar event intelligible; this single-code practice belongs with no other code.

second_order: disputing whether a builder was sabotaging Sevarog
theme_note: An accusation and denial contest whether visible pixels are help or sabotage rather than coordinating a design.
Moderator-style removals and member responses enact a temporary rule that ordinary posts must concern Iggy and Scorch; templates, mock bans, and tests of seriousness vary.

second_order: filling the subreddit with Buff Iggy riffs
theme_note: Members make standalone slogans, devotion, duels, images, and absurd claims that visibly populate the makeover rather than answer ordinary game talk.

second_order: pulling ordinary Paragon talk into the Iggy joke
theme_note: Replies interrupt or rewrite matchmaking, balance, support, and other game discussions with Iggy language; the host topic varies but the recruiting move is shared.

second_order: baiting and explaining April Fools claims
theme_note: Straight-faced false or ambiguous claims draw recognition, questions, admissions, and explanations that make the temporary joke legible.

second_order: sending Iggy jokes toward other subreddits
theme_note: The joke is pointed beyond r/paragon by proposing another subreddit as its destination or headquarters.

second_order: maintaining and repairing the Paragon mark
theme_note: Members salvage, watch, repair, and persist against stray pixels; completion reports and overnight labour mark different points in that upkeep.

second_order: cleaning up and remembering the Iggy takeover
theme_note: Members mark the end, restore the subreddit, recall the volume of posts, and keep discussing when the joke was over.

second_order: sizing and positioning the mark around neighbours
theme_note: Participants propose where and how large to build while treating neighbouring artwork and territory as constraints.
Members relay warnings and denials, distinguish individuals from groups, invoke Discord reports, apologize, and propose mutual restraint around neighbouring marks.

second_order: revising the Paragon mark's colour plan
theme_note: A new white-on-black instruction is clarified after a misread so maintainers will stop reverting one another.

second_order: looking back on a modest finished mark
theme_note: Members praise the result, recall defense, note the missing Sevarog and limited people, and ask where the small mark can be found.
